title: Virtual Staging & Photo Enhancement

blueprintSignals.name: Structure preservation
blueprintSignals.definition: edge-map similarity between the original and staged image outside the furniture mask
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Mask the furniture region, otherwise added furniture lowers the score

blueprintSignals.name: Lighting consistency
blueprintSignals.definition: angle between the dominant shadow direction in the room and on the added furniture
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Estimate light from fixed features, because windows and lamps vary

blueprintSignals.name: Style fit
blueprintSignals.definition: style classifier score against the chosen target style such as modern or traditional
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Taste differs by market, so validate with local raters

blueprintSignals.name: Disclosure flag
blueprintSignals.definition: presence of the visible label detected in the final image
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Test on images after portal resizing and cropping

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Virtual Staging & Photo Enhancement": Furnish empty rooms and enhance photos with generative models, clearly labelled, to help buyers imagine the space. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Evaluating only on easy, simple rooms hides failures in cluttered or oddly shaped ones.
